-- SOC-002 · generated from the card contract · non-normative
WITH cases AS (
  SELECT date_diff('second', occurred_at, detected_at) / 3600.0 AS ttd_h,
         CASE severity WHEN 'P1' THEN 4.0 WHEN 'P2' THEN 2.0 ELSE 1.0 END AS severity_weight
  FROM incidents
  WHERE detected_at >= :period_start AND detected_at < :period_end
    AND confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND confirmed_at <= :period_end
    AND confirmed_at >= detected_at
    AND scope_id = :scope_id
    AND occurred_at IS NOT NULL AND detected_at IS NOT NULL
    AND detected_at >= occurred_at
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS valid_cases,
       CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ttd_h) END AS p50_h,
       CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE percentile_disc(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ttd_h) END AS p90_h,
       AVG(ttd_h) AS mean_h_supplementary,
       SUM(severity_weight * ttd_h) / NULLIF(SUM(severity_weight), 0) AS severity_weighted_avg
FROM cases;
-- P50 true median, P90 exact nearest rank; empty case base -> NULL = n/a, never 0

// SOC-002 - non-normative; exact median and nearest-rank P90.
let p_start = datetime(2026-06-01);
let p_end = datetime(2026-07-01);
let scope = "prod";
incidents
| where scope_id == scope and detected_at >= p_start and detected_at < p_end
| where isnotnull(confirmed_at) and confirmed_at <= p_end and confirmed_at >= detected_at
| where isnotnull(occurred_at) and isnotnull(detected_at) and detected_at >= occurred_at
| extend ttd_h = (detected_at - occurred_at) / 1h,
         w = case(severity == "P1", 4.0, severity == "P2", 2.0, 1.0)
| summarize valid_cases = count(), arr = make_list(ttd_h, 1048576),
            mean_h_supplementary = avg(ttd_h), weighted_sum = sum(w * ttd_h), weight_sum = sum(w)
| extend s = array_sort_asc(arr), n = array_length(arr)
| extend p50_h = iff(n == 0 or n != valid_cases, real(null),
                     (todouble(s[toint(ceiling(0.5*n))-1]) + todouble(s[toint(0.5*n)]))/2.0),
         p90_h = iff(n == 0 or n != valid_cases, real(null), todouble(s[toint(ceiling(0.9*n))-1])),
         severity_weighted_avg = iff(weight_sum == 0, real(null), weighted_sum / weight_sum)
| project valid_cases, p50_h, p90_h, mean_h_supplementary, severity_weighted_avg
// Array truncation invalidates percentiles; partition or use an exact external sort for larger cohorts.

``` SOC-002 · generated from the card contract · non-normative ```
index=security_incidents sourcetype=incident scope_id=$scope_id$
| where detected_at >= $period_start$ AND detected_at < $period_end$
| where isnotnull(confirmed_at) AND confirmed_at <= $period_end$ AND confirmed_at >= detected_at
| where isnotnull(occurred_at) AND isnotnull(detected_at)
        AND detected_at >= occurred_at
| eval ttd_h = (detected_at - occurred_at) / 3600
| eval w = case(severity == "P1", 4, severity == "P2", 2, true(), 1), wd = w * ttd_h
| eventstats sum(wd) AS wd_sum, sum(w) AS w_sum
| eval weighted_mean = wd_sum / w_sum
| sort 0 ttd_h
| streamstats count AS rk
| eventstats count AS n, avg(ttd_h) AS mean_h
| eval is50a = if(rk == ceiling(0.5 * n), ttd_h, null()),
       is50b = if(rk == floor(0.5 * n) + 1, ttd_h, null()),
       is90  = if(rk == ceiling(0.9 * n), ttd_h, null())
| stats max(n) AS valid_cases, max(is50a) AS p50_lo, max(is50b) AS p50_hi,
        max(is90) AS p90_h, max(mean_h) AS mean_h_supplementary, max(weighted_mean) AS severity_weighted_avg
| eval p50_h = (p50_lo + p50_hi) / 2
| fields valid_cases, p50_h, p90_h, mean_h_supplementary, severity_weighted_avg

snippets.dax:
// SOC-002 · generated from the card contract · non-normative
MTTD P90 (h) :=
VAR ValidCases =
    FILTER (
        Incidents,
        Incidents[detected_at] >= [Period Start]
            && Incidents[detected_at] < [Period End]
            && NOT ISBLANK ( Incidents[confirmed_at] )
            && Incidents[confirmed_at] <= [Period End]
            && Incidents[confirmed_at] >= Incidents[detected_at]
            && Incidents[scope_id] = [Selected Scope]
            && NOT ISBLANK ( Incidents[occurred_at] )
            && NOT ISBLANK ( Incidents[detected_at] )
            && Incidents[detected_at] >= Incidents[occurred_at]
    )
VAR WithTtd =
    ADDCOLUMNS ( ValidCases, "@ttd_h",
        DATEDIFF ( Incidents[occurred_at], Incidents[detected_at], SECOND ) / 3600.0 )
VAR n   = COUNTROWS ( WithTtd )
VAR r90 = ROUNDUP ( 0.9 * n, 0 )
RETURN
    IF ( n = 0, BLANK (),
         MAXX ( TOPN ( r90, WithTtd, [@ttd_h], ASC ), [@ttd_h] ) )
// siblings: P50 via MEDIANX ( WithTtd, [@ttd_h] ); mean via AVERAGEX
// Supplementary severity_weighted_avg uses SUMX(WithTtd, w * [@ttd_h]) / SUMX(WithTtd, w),
// w = SWITCH(Incidents[severity], "P1", 4.0, "P2", 2.0, 1.0).
// This displayed measure implements P90 only; sibling measures require implementation.

# SOC-002 · generated from the card contract · non-normative
import math
import pandas as pd

def mttd(incidents: pd.DataFrame,
         period_start, period_end, scope_id):
    base = incidents[
        (incidents["detected_at"] >= period_start)
        & (incidents["detected_at"] < period_end)
        & incidents["confirmed_at"].notna()
        & (incidents["confirmed_at"] <= period_end)
        & (incidents["confirmed_at"] >= incidents["detected_at"])
        & (incidents["scope_id"] == scope_id)
        & incidents["occurred_at"].notna()
        & incidents["detected_at"].notna()
    ]
    ttd_h = ((base["detected_at"] - base["occurred_at"])
             .dt.total_seconds() / 3600.0)
    ttd_h = ttd_h[ttd_h >= 0].sort_values()
    n = len(ttd_h)
    if n == 0:
        return None                      # n/a - never 0
    weights = base.loc[ttd_h.index, "severity"].map({"P1": 4.0, "P2": 2.0}).fillna(1.0)
    return {
        "valid_cases": n,
        "p50_h": ttd_h.median(),
        "p90_h": ttd_h.iloc[math.ceil(0.9 * n) - 1],   # nearest rank
        "mean_h_supplementary": float(ttd_h.mean()),
        "severity_weighted_avg": float((ttd_h * weights).sum() / weights.sum()),
    }
